content.description: TxNerd is a Cardano transaction analysis platform that imports, categorises, and exports wallet transactions to CSV format for cryptocurrency tax reporting. It bridges the gap between Cardano's blockchain and major tax software platforms like Recap and Awaken that don't support Cardano natively. The platform specialises exclusively in Cardano, handling its technical complexities to provide accurate transaction classification.
